The AI 2 rail fails the ten-second test. I logged it as a `ui` flag for mastermind-servex in `flags.jsonl`, since the fix is code and I didn't touch it.

- **Status:** I couldn't tell it. The top three cards sit under "Waiting on you 131" but each one is ticked. The header also says "Needs you 42" against 131 in the list.
- **Asked and delivered:** Each row is a title plus a cut-off "landed after d…" line. That doesn't say what was asked or what came back.
- **My fix:** Put ticked cards in their own Done group. Make both counts the same number. Show asked and delivered as one line per card.

I didn't find a separate done card to check on this view.
